title: FreedomCore Atlas Security Posture & Audit Evidence Schema (v3.1)

fields.control_id: Primary key. Canonical Atlas security/provenance control identifier (ATLAS-SEC-01 through ATLAS-SEC-12).
fields.category: Control domain category (transport, payment isolation, privacy, entity resolution, fail-closed inventory, two-clock provenance, receipt admission, media integrity, hold enforcement, feed integrity, retirement governance, claims boundary).
fields.control_title: Plain-language title of the enforced security or provenance control.
fields.verified_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last successful verification of the cited evidence artifact (null when staged; kept unchanged when a re-check fails).
fields.evidence_artifact: Canonical public URL or workspace evidence artifact path backing the control.
fields.evidence_sha256: 64-hex SHA-256 digest of the named evidence_artifact.
fields.public_evidence_url: Live clickable https://atlas.freedomcore.io/... URL where the control can be inspected.
fields.reproducible_check: Step-by-step instructions for an external reviewer to verify the control independently.
fields.scope_and_limits: Explicit boundary stating what the control covers and what requires external retesting.
fields.evidence_http_status_now: HTTP status of evidence_artifact at links_checked_at, or internal_file_checked for withheld internal files.
fields.public_evidence_http_status_now: HTTP status of public_evidence_url at links_checked_at.
fields.links_checked_at: ISO-8601 UTC time of this row's link and fingerprint check.
